summary.text: Eric Matthews is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 66 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An educator at Chief Joseph Middle School, he was born in Bozeman.

paragraphs.text: Matthews was born in Bozeman, graduated from Bozeman High School in 1992, and earned two degrees from Montana State University.
His career experience includes working as an educator at Chief Joseph Middle School.
He served as vice president of the Bozeman Education Association and on the board of the Montana Federation of Public Employees.
Matthews took office on January 2, 2023, succeeding Democrat Denise Hayman.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Rules and Appropriations committees; in 2023-2024 he served on the Business and Labor, House Education, and Fish, Wildlife and Parks committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
